full_judgment: 2. Relevant facts for the purpose or the case, in short, are that the opposite parties as plaintiffs instituted a suit in the Court of the Assistant Judge, Madargonj praying for recovery of the suit land measuring 5 decimals under section 9 of the Specific Relief Act The plaintiffs case is that they have been owning and possessing the suit property for quite a long period by using the same as their homestead and by planting bamboo clumps and other valuable trees thereon. The defendants recently created some forged and fabricated documents for laying false claim upon the suit property for illegally grabbing the same and in pursuance thereof they held out threats to disposes them and under such circumstances the plaintiffs were constrained to file a criminal case against the defendants, being Court Case No. 117(c) before the Magistrate, Madargonj under sections 144/145/107 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. While the aforesaid Criminal case was progressing the defendants illegally dispossessed the plaintiffs from the suit land by Cutting trees and by constructing tin-shed structures and straw-huts therein and this necessitated the filing of the present suit
